questions.stem: Interpol (International Criminal Police Organization) moved its General Secretariat from Paris to which city in 1989, where it has remained ever since?

options.option_text: Paris, France — Interpol's European HQ location until 1989
Lyon, France — Interpol's General Secretariat since 1989
Brussels, Belgium — seat of NATO and EU intergovernmental bodies
Vienna, Austria — original founding city of Interpol in 1923

questions.explanation: Interpol relocated its General Secretariat from Paris to Lyon in 1989 for operational and logistical reasons; Lyon remains the HQ today. Paris is the most tempting distractor because Interpol was indeed based there from 1946 to 1989, and Vienna, while Interpol's founding city (1923), has not hosted the Secretariat in the modern era.

questions.stem: The Commonwealth Secretariat, established in 1965 to serve the intergovernmental network of 56 member nations, is located at Marlborough House in which city?

options.option_text: Ottawa, Canada — seat of the Canadian federal government
New Delhi, India — home to the largest Commonwealth member
London, United Kingdom — at historic Marlborough House
Canberra, Australia — Pacific-region Commonwealth hub

questions.explanation: The Commonwealth Secretariat has operated from Marlborough House, London since 1965 by historical convention. New Delhi is the most tempting distractor because India is the largest Commonwealth member by population, but the Secretariat has never shifted from London. Ottawa and Canberra, while prominent Commonwealth capitals, have no claim to the Secretariat.

questions.stem: The New Development Bank (NDB), established in 2015 by BRICS nations to finance infrastructure in emerging economies, has its headquarters in which city?

options.option_text: Beijing, China — where China's central government is located
Shanghai, China — the NDB's operational headquarters since 2015
New Delhi, India — largest BRICS nation by population
Johannesburg, South Africa — Africa's financial capital city

questions.explanation: The NDB was formally inaugurated with its headquarters in Shanghai in July 2015, chosen as China's financial capital rather than Beijing (China's political capital). Beijing is the classic distractor because candidates assume a China-based institution defaults to the capital. Johannesburg is wrong; South Africa's seat of government is Pretoria.

questions.stem: The International Renewable Energy Agency (IRENA), established in 2009 to drive global clean-energy transition, is headquartered in which city?

options.option_text: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia — the Gulf's dominant oil economy capital
Dubai, United Arab Emirates — the UAE's global commerce hub
Doha, Qatar — host of COP18 climate change negotiations
Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates — IRENA's permanent host since 2009

questions.explanation: IRENA's founding conference in 2009 selected Abu Dhabi as permanent headquarters after a competitive bid; the UAE capital committed significant land and funding. Dubai is the most common distractor because of its global profile, but IRENA sits in Abu Dhabi. Doha hosts COP events and Riyadh is a major Gulf capital, but neither hosts IRENA.

questions.stem: The International Telecommunication Union (ITU), which allocates global radio spectrum and satellite orbital slots, is headquartered in which city?

options.option_text: Geneva, Switzerland — ITU's permanent home since 1947
Vienna, Austria — home of IAEA, UNIDO, and CTBTO
Brussels, Belgium — EU's main seat and telecom regulatory hub
Paris, France — headquarters of UNESCO and OECD

questions.explanation: The ITU, originally the International Telegraph Union founded in 1865, moved its headquarters to Geneva in 1948 when it became a UN specialized agency. Vienna is the most tempting distractor because it hosts several other UN bodies (IAEA, UNIDO, CTBTO), but not ITU. Brussels handles EU telecom regulation, not ITU's global mandate.

questions.stem: Which United Nations specialized agency focused on rural poverty and agricultural lending shares its host city with both the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the World Food Programme (WFP)?

options.option_text: Geneva, Switzerland — the primary hub for UN health and labour
Vienna, Austria — base of UNIDO and multiple UN bodies
Rome, Italy — the UN's global food and agriculture capital
Washington DC, USA — location of the World Bank and IMF

questions.explanation: Rome hosts all three UN food agencies: FAO, WFP, and IFAD (International Fund for Agricultural Development). This trio makes Rome the UN's food-sector capital — a PYQ-favourite niche detail. Geneva is the most tempting distractor because it hosts WHO, ILO, and WTO, but none of the three food agencies. Washington DC hosts the Bretton Woods institutions (World Bank, IMF), not food bodies.

questions.stem: The Financial Action Task Force (FATF), the global standard-setter for combating money laundering and terrorism financing, is physically hosted at the premises of which Paris-based organisation?

options.option_text: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development (OECD)
United Nations Educational Scientific Organisation (UNESCO)
International Chamber of Commerce (ICC) — a Paris-based body
Interpol — the police body formerly headquartered in Paris

questions.explanation: FATF was established in 1989 at the G7 Paris Summit and has been hosted at OECD's Paris campus ever since, though it is operationally independent. UNESCO is the most tempting distractor because it is the best-known Paris-based UN body, but UNESCO has no connection to financial crime standards. Interpol, though formerly Paris-based, now operates from Lyon and is not FATF's host.
